title: Security Engineer II
description:
**Requisition Number:** **106306**

**Security Engineer II – Zscaler**

**Location**: This is a hybrid opportunity in Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram area.

**Insight** **at a Glance**

* 14,000+ engaged teammates globally with operations in 25 countries across the globe.

* Received 35+ industry and partner awards in the past year

* $9.2 billion in revenue

* #20 on Fortune’s World's Best Workplaces™ list

* #14 on Forbes World's Best Employers in IT – 2023

* #23 on Forbes Best Employers for Women in IT- 2023

* $1.4M+ total charitable contributions in 2023 by Insight globally

Now is the time to bring your expertise to Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organisations through complex digital decisions.

**About the** **role**

As a Security Engineer II – Zscaler, you will support and optimize Zscaler Internet Access, Zscaler Private Access, and Zscaler Digital Experience environments. We will count on you to deploy, troubleshoot, and improve secure connectivity, access policies, and end-user experience across client environments. Along the way, you will get to:

* Configure and troubleshoot ZIA, ZPA, and ZDX, including traffic flow, SSL inspection, app segments, access policies, and PAC files.

* Set up and support GRE and IPSec tunnels, SD-WAN integrated sites, remote users, and mobile user connectivity.

* Analyze ZDX telemetry, logs, and reports using SecureCRT, PuTTY, and Fiddler to resolve connectivity, performance, and security issues.

* Work in a ticket-driven environment, document resolutions, troubleshoot firewalls, and optimize Zscaler policies to reduce complexity.

* Be AmbITious: This opportunity is not just about what you do today but also about where you can go tomorrow. When you bring your hunger, heart, and harmony to Insight, your potential will be met with continuous opportunities to upskill, earn promotions, and elevate your career.

**What** **we’re** **looking for**

* B.E., B.Tech., or graduate qualification with 3–4 years of relevant experience, including hands-on Zscaler experience.

* Strong understanding of ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, routing and switching, SSL handshakes, SSL inspection, GRE, IPSec, and SD-WAN.

* Experience with PAC file modifications, ZPA app segments, access policies, advanced security tools, and firewall troubleshooting.

* Strong problem-solving, documentation, stakeholder communication, and ticket management skills, including ServiceNow exposure.

**What you can expect**

We’re legendary for taking care of you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. We want you to enjoy a full, meaningful life and own your career at Insight. Some of our benefits include:

* Freedom to work from another location—even an international destination—for up to 30 consecutive calendar days per year.

* Medical Insurance

* Health Benefits

* Professional Development: Learning Platform and Certificate Reimbursement

* Shift Allowance

But what really sets us apart are our core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony, which guide everything we do, from building relationships with teammates, partners, and clients to making a positive impact in our communities.

**Join us today, your ambITious journey starts here**.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.  
  
At Insight, we celebrate diversity of skills and experience so even if you don’t feel like your skills are a perfect match - we still want to hear from you!  
  
Today's talent leads tomorrow's success. Learn more about Insight:  
https://www.linkedin.com/company/insight/

***Insight does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. Unsolicited resumes will be treated as direct applications from the candidate, and recruiters or agencies who submit candidates for this position without a prior, written vendor agreement will not be eligible for any form of compensation, even if the candidate is hired.***

Insight is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Security Analyst
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Sep 30, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1745370

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Information Security Analyst – Sr. Associate**
------------------------------------------------

Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

  

**The opportunity**
-------------------

The Technology Assurance, Risk, and Policy (TARP) function within Information Security strives to create and promote a holistic Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program by creating a robust, resilient, and proactive governance framework, supported by a strategic risk management approach and stringent compliance structures. It aims to integrate and align its GRC initiatives in line with the global firm's objectives and emerging threats within the cybersecurity landscape.

The Technology Assurance team develops provides security assurance on EY’s deployed technology to internal and external stakeholders. The team members act as subject matter experts across a number of information and cyber security disciplines that include, among others, application and network penetrating testing and vulnerabilities identification, information security audits, compliance to cyber security and regulatory frameworks, and conducting or coordinating security audits and assessments. The team develops the overall strategy and for implementing various technical attack and penetration assessment, information security audits like HITRUST, SOC 1 and SOC 2 to provide third-party assurance to EY’s Clients in EY’s senior leadership. The team is responsible of overseeing and leading the technical audit process that includes third-party external assessments of client-facing critical business applications, M365 Teams Apps, Network, cloud configuration reviews, infrastructure reviews, UK Cyber Essentials Plus Certification and UK IT Health Check Certification. The team manages Attack and Penetration testing controls based on Industry Standards and obtain third-party security attestations/certifications to enable EY Business to win in the market. The team also manages and maintains the firm’s ISO 27001 certifications is responsible for the end-end delivery of attestation audits like SOC 1 and SOC2. Technical compliance to regulatory framework like Internation Standard on Quality Management (ISQM) is also a responsibility of the team.

  

An Information Security Analyst will work closely with team leads to assist with one of the security functional areas described above.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Create creating various process documents and assist with the maintenance of the team’s internal procedure and process documents.
* Assist with one or more of the following areas:
  + Develop comprehensive Information Security technical audit plans and schedules based on client demands, regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and organizational objectives.
  + Maintain the firm’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) and participate in the various ISO 27001 activities like risk assessments, maintain monitoring framework for key security metrics and remediation tracking of observations and finding.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including IT teams, compliance teams, ET and CT, to ensure alignment of audit activities with organizational goals and priorities.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation of vulnerabilities, remediation plans, and risk mitigation strategies to share with stakeholders and clients.
* Stay informed about emerging threats, attack vectors, and security vulnerabilities affecting the organization’s technology stack.
* Collaboration with other Information Security groups and external stakeholders across EY is key to this role.

**Skills and attributes for success**
-------------------------------------

* Strong Background in various Information Technology domains
* Working knowledge of Information Security concepts
* Excellent organizational and coordination abilities
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, and analyse information
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt to a fast-moving environment
* Critical thinking skills
* Strong time management skills

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**
-----------------------------------------

* Min 3 years of experience in an information security or technology audit field
* Ability to work collaboratively with various teams to obtain an in-depth understanding of the process and the documentation requirements
* Ability to deliver high quality documentation paying attention to every detail
* Ability to quickly grasp complex technical concepts and make them easily understandable in text and pictures
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Must be a strong multi-tasker and be able to prioritize duties

**Ideally, you’ll also have**
-----------------------------

* Bachelors or above in Information Technology or Cyber Security related Degrees
* Keen interest in pursuing relevant Information Security Certifications like CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 lead auditor, ISO 42001 lead auditor/implementer, CISA, etc.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:

* **Continuous learning:** You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: BUK TESCO Bank - Core Banking Infrastructure Engineer - BA4
description:
Date live: 10/16/2026

Business Area: Customer Digital and Data

Area of Expertise: Technology

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000136180

  

As a Service Engineer at Barclays TESCO Bank, where you will play a key role in the supporting applications end-to-end, enhancing capabilities, and delivery continuous improvement of core banking platforms. You will be responsible for ensuring the resilience, performance, and integrity of critical systems while contributing to strategic change and operational excellence within the technology function.

To be successful in this role, you will need experience in:

* **Application Support & Service Delivery**
    
  Leading and Providing end-to-end L2/L3 support for core banking applications, ensuring adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and operational KPIs. Proactively monitoring system health, managing incidents and service requests, and ensuring high availability of business-critical services.

* **Driving End to End Automation**

Lead the implementation of end-to-end CI/CD automation using Gitlab, Jenkins and Nexus, reducing manual effort while improving deployment consistency, Security and release efficiency.

* **Containerisation, Kubernetes & EKS Engineering**

Hands on proficiency in containerisation, including Docker and Kubernetes/EKS, with the ability to troubleshoot workloads, optimise cluster performance, and design/maintain Helm charts.

* **Maintenance & Continuous Improvement**
    
  Supporting ongoing maintenance activities including defect resolution, patching, and platform upgrades. Driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance application stability, performance, and scalability in line with Barclays’ strategic technology objectives.

* **Change, Release & Environment Management**
    
  Managing application changes through the Barclays change governance framework, ensuring controlled and compliant deployments across environments. Supporting release activities with minimal disruption to production services.

* **Incident, Problem & Root Cause Analysis**
    
  Leading incident triage, performing root cause analysis, and implementing permanent fixes. Contributing to problem management processes to reduce recurring incidents and improve system resilience.

* **Stakeholder Collaboration & Demand Support**
    
  Working closely with business users, development teams, and infrastructure partners to manage demand, prioritise enhancements, and support delivery of the application backlog and strategic initiatives.

* **Operational Excellence & Process Optimisation**
    
  Identifying opportunities to streamline processes, automate repetitive tasks, and implement best practices to improve operational efficiency and user experience.

* **Risk, Compliance & Controls**
    
  Ensuring compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards. Supporting risk management activities including controls monitoring, incident reporting, and documentation (e.g., RCSAs, records inventory).

* **Environment & Infrastructure Coordination**
    
  Collaborating with infrastructure, database, and middleware teams to manage application environments, capacity planning, and performance tuning.

* **Business Continuity & Resilience**
    
  Supporting disaster recovery planning, failover testing, and continuity processes to ensure minimal disruption to critical banking services.

* **Domain** Banking & Financial Systems

* **Technical Skills** AWS, GitLab, Jenkins, Terraform and Ansible, Kubernetes, Nexus, Python or PowerShell or Any scripting Language Windows/RHEL

* **Good-To-Have:** Datadog , Snyk or SonarQube, ServiceNow/JIRA/Confluence, Java , Safe Agile, Knowledge Fiserv suite of applications

**You may also require the following skills and experience:**

Strong understanding of ITIL practices (Incident, Problem, Change Management)

Experience working within regulated financial services environments.

Ability to manage competing priorities in a high-pressure production support environment.

Effective communication and stakeholder management skills

Continuous learning mindset to adapt to evolving banking technologies and platforms.

  
  

You may be assessed on the key skills needed for success in this role, including application support, incident and problem management, risk and controls, system reliability, and technical expertise in banking platforms.

  
  

This role is based in our Bengaluru office.

**Purpose of the role**

To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior AI Governance Specialist
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

Senior AI Governance Specialist, ASSET MANAGEMENT

Northern Trust Asset Management (NTAM) is an over a trillion-dollar investment management firm entrusted by investors around the globe to help them navigate changing market environments, so they can confidently realize their long-term objectives.

NTAM has embarked on an ambitious plan to modernize its Data and AI capabilities and embed a data-driven culture throughout the organization. The Data Governance Specialist will pride themselves in taking a customer first approach to truly make it easier for our internal customers to protect, enhance and instill trust in our data to generate insight and deliver the best client experience.

The key focus of this role is to assist the company adopt AI quickly and safely. You will turn AI governance policy and standards into practical controls, assess AI use cases and models for risk, and give business teams clear guidance on what good looks like. You will work across Data, Technology, Risk, Legal and the business, reporting to the Head of Data and Analytics.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support projects and establish responsible, safe AI practice across NTAM. Responsibilities include:

**Data management**

* Check that data used in AI systems has a clear owner, documented lineage, quality checks and appropriate access controls.
* Explicit evaluation of data completeness, suitability, ownership, lineage, quality and governance
* Maintain the AI inventory and link each model to its source data, classification and retention requirements. Extend inventory coverage beyond models and use cases to AI systems, platforms, agents, agentic solutions, digital workers and vended AI capabilities

**AI model risk management**

* Work closely with the Enterprise Model Risk Management teams and Front line AI model governance team to run risk assessments on AI use cases and models, covering bias, explainability, privacy, security and third-party risk.
* Support model validation, ongoing monitoring and issue tracking in line with model risk principles (independent challenge, documentation, performance and drift thresholds).
* Assist to develop frameworks to map controls to applicable regulations and standards, such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF and linked up with our NT AI Policy and Standards.
* Importantly, the role is about training NTAM AI key stakeholders, ie model owner, engineers, architects and data practitioners on how to perform these actions and ensure controls are in place so that this becomes a repeatable process.

**Safe AI adoption**

* Review new AI requests, advise teams on risk tiers and required controls, and escalate high-risk cases.
* Develop guidance, templates and training that make responsible AI use easy for non-technical colleagues.
* Report governance metrics and emerging risks to senior stakeholders and the AI governance committee.

**AI telemetry and guardrail monitoring**

* Help define and maintain the telemetry that shows AI systems are behaving as intended, such as usage, prompt and output flags, policy violations, model drift, error rates and human override rates.
* Review dashboards and alerts to confirm guardrails (content filters, access limits, data loss controls) are working as expected, and investigate gaps or false positives with engineering teams.
* Log and track incidents through to resolution, and feed lessons back into controls, thresholds and risk assessments.
* Report back to Senior Management on AI portfolio telemetry to ensure that there is transparency from different AI initiatives (prioritized by risk tiering) with clear action owner, target date, closure evidence and escalation points, rather than only tracking incidents through resolution.

**Training and change management**

* Design and deliver AI governance and responsible AI training for employees, managers and technical teams, tailored to each audience.
* Lead change management for governance rollouts: stakeholder mapping, communications, champions network and feedback loops.
* Measure adoption and behavior change (training completion, policy adherence, intake quality) and adjust the approach to improve it.
* Mentor junior analysts and set practice standards for the team.
* Interface with AI Intake process to check submissions for completeness, perform initial classification and routing using defined criteria, challenge unsupported assertions or unclear ownership, and escalate incomplete or potentially higher-risk submissions
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Explicitly include Technology, Data, Privacy, Cyber, Model Risk, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, TPRM and business teams, with responsibility for following up on information, actions and evidence.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify improvements to templates, trackers, reporting processes and documentation quality to make oversight more consistent, efficient and scalable.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 6 months: the AI inventory is complete and every use case is risk-tiered.
* Business teams get governance guidance quickly and rate the process as clear and useful.
* High-risk models have documented validation and active monitoring.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  

* Working knowledge of data management practice: data quality, lineage, metadata, classification and privacy.
* Proven domain knowledge in financial services
* Understanding of model risk principles and the AI/ML lifecycle, including validation, monitoring and bias testing.
* Ability to read a policy or regulation and turn it into clear, testable controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable advising senior and non-technical audiences, with a track record of delivering training and driving adoption of new ways of working.
* Practical, pragmatic mindset that enables adoption rather than blocking it.
* Bachelor's degree in data science, engineering, risk, law, business or a related field.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or insurance.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7 or DAMA-DMBOK.
* Certifications such as AIGP, CDMP, CRISC or CIPP.

KEY BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  

* Business acumen, and the ability to communicate to executives, business domain stakeholders and technical staff.
* Strong project management, acumen and familiarity working in agile environments.
* Experience with innovation and ideation methods, such as design thinking and product management.
* Demonstrated influence, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work well with others and exhibit leadership.
* Be an excellent communicator and collaborator, engaging with multiple technical and business stakeholders and leaders. Team player with collaborative and inclusive approach.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

The Senior Information Security Analyst serves as an experienced individual contributor and first-shift technical resource within the CDC. This position provides guidance to junior analysts, supports investigation and escalation of security events, tracks remediation activities, improves operational procedures, and helps strengthen overall security operations.

This role will also support operational maturity by training selected **NOC engineers** to perform **Tier 1 security alert triage,** including alert validation, initial documentation, escalation criteria, and handoff to the CDC.

**It’s more than a career at NAB. It’s about more meaningful work, more global opportunities and more innovation beyond boundaries .**

Your job is just one part of your life. When you bring your ideas, energy, and hunger for growth, you’ll be recognised and rewarded for your contribution in return. You’ll have our support to excel for our customers, deliver positive change for our communities and grow your career.

NAB has established NAB Innovation Centre India as a centre for operations and technology excellence to support NAB deliver faster, better, and more personalized experience to customers and colleagues.

At NAB India, we’re ramping-up and growing at a very fast pace. Our passionate leaders recruit and develop high performing people, empowering them to deliver exceptional outcomes to make a positive difference in the lives of our customers and our communities.

The Opportunity

Step into a role where you move from contributing to owning. As a Platform Engineer (SDE2) at NAB, you will be a trusted, independent member of the team responsible for the end-to-end delivery of features and services that empower thousands of developers across the bank. You will take ownership of key components within our multi-cloud Internal Developer Platform, designing, building, and maintaining the tools that enable our engineering teams to ship software faster and more securely. This is an opportunity to deepen your expertise in cloud-native technologies, drive meaningful improvements to the developer experience, and play a vital role in our mission to become Australia's best engineering bank.

What You'll Do

As a SDE2, you will be a hands-on builder, taking ideas from concept to production and ensuring their ongoing reliability and performance.

* **Design and Build Platform Services:** Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable and reliable components of our developer platform, focusing on areas such as secure CI/CD, observability, on-demand environments, or cloud infrastructure management.
* **Manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Build and manage our multi-cloud infrastructure, using IaC principles and tools. You will create reusable modules and automated workflows for provisioning and managing resources.
* **Enhance CI/CD Pipelines:** Develop and enhance secure, high-velocity CI/CD pipelines using tools like Harness, ensuring robust automation for the build, testing, and deployment of a wide variety of applications.
* **Implement Observability:** Implement and manage comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) to provide deep visibility into the health and performance of our platform services and hosted applications.
* **Improve Developer Experience:** Collaborate closely with product engineering teams to understand their pain points, gather requirements, and build self-service tools and workflows that make their lives easier.
* **Uphold Engineering Excellence:** Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to your peers. You will also contribute to technical design discussions and help maintain high standards for code quality and system reliability.
* **Implementing Ephemeral Infrastructure:** Build and implement on-demand, ephemeral environments that can come up automatedly, from our internal developer portals spawning up all the dependencies with components of test automation running as part of the on-demand infrastructure spin up.
* **Nack for Risk and Security:** As part of being a banking / financial institution, security and risk in ingrained in our daily activity. A key competency would be not just building great tech but also building with the best practices of security & risk ingrained in our daily work.

What You'll Bring

We are looking for experienced engineers with a passion for automation, reliability, and building tools that developers love to use.

* **Experience:** 4-7 years of professional experience in a Platform Engineering, DevOps, or a backend engineering role.
* **Cloud Proficiency:** Hands-on experience building and managing infrastructure in at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Google Cloud), with exposure to core services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, or their equivalents.
* **Container and Orchestration Expertise:** Strong, practical experience with containerization using Docker and container orchestration using Kubernetes. You should be comfortable writing Kubernetes manifests and managing workloads.
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Proven proficiency with IaC tools such as Terraform and Ansible for automating infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
* **CI/CD Implementation:** Demonstrable experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools like Harness, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar.
* **Programming and Scripting:** Strong programming and scripting skills in languages such as Python, Go, Java, or Shell, with a focus on writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

Good to Have

These skills are not mandatory but will set you apart and enable you to make a faster impact:

* Experience with advanced CI/CD and deployment orchestration tools like Harness.
* Knowledge of service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd) for managing microservices communication.
* Familiarity with building developer tools or portals using TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks.
* Experience working in a regulated financial services environment and an understanding of associated security and compliance requirements.
* Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate).

Our goal is to foster a culture that fills us with pride, rooted in trust and respect. NAB is committed to creating a positive and supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to embrace their true, authentic selves. A diverse and inclusive workplace where our differences are celebrated, and our contributions are valued. It’s a huge part of what makes NAB such a special place to be.

We support our colleagues to balance their careers and personal life through flexible working arrangements such as hybrid working and job sharing and competitive financial and lifestyle benefits. We invest in our colleagues through world class development programs (Distinctive Leadership and Career Qualified in Banking), and empower you to learn, grow and pursue exciting career opportunities

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1744972

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY INFORMATION SECURITY**

**Job posting**

**AI and Automation Engineering Lead, Associate Director**

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build.

EY focuses on high ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities.

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

  

**The opportunity**

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI.

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function.

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people.

  

**Areas of focus**

* **AI Engineering:** Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output.
* **Functional AI Leadership:** Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes.
* **Automation Delivery:** Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time.
* **Assurance of AI Output:** Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it.
* **AI Standards and Capability:** Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program.

  

**Key responsibilities**

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems.
* Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces.
* Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take.
* Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them.
* Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue.
* Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data.
* Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved.
* Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program.
* Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others.
* Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality.
* Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on.
* Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual.
* Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership.
* Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders.
* Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience.
* Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program.
* Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines.
* Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production.
* Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK.
* Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task.
* Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable.
* Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent.
* Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph.
* Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs.
* A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes.
* Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling.
* Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it.
* Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams.

  

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources.
* Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path.
* Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation.
* Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling.
* Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers.
* Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering.

  

**What we look for**

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used.

  

**What we offer**

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:

* **Continuous learning:** You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Security Engineer - Cloud & AI Platform
description:
**About Ema**
=============

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.  
  
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Ema builds AI agents that act on sensitive enterprise data and systems. You’ll make sure the agents, and the platform they run on, are secure by design. You’ll build security controls for autonomous agents operating across multi-tenant enterprise environments, including cloud, on-prem and air-gapped deployments. You’ll solve zero-trust problems where the code isn’t static logic but non-deterministic models making live API calls against sensitive customer data. Our agents orchestrate 100+ LLMs, call third-party tools through MCP, execute code in sandboxes and drive headless browsers, and each of those is an attack surface you’ll help define.

**What you’ll own**
===================

***AI and agent security***
---------------------------

* Threat model new AI agent features before launch: direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration through agent outputs, and over-privileged tool use
* Design guardrails for agentic workflows: least-privilege tool and connector scopes, human-in-the-loop approvals for high-risk actions, and output filtering
* Enforce tenant and data isolation across retrieval (RAG), context stores, and model calls, so no customer’s data leaks into another’s context
* Secure the AI supply chain: model and provider vetting, third-party MCP servers and connectors, prompt and config versioning
* Run AI red-team exercises and build automated adversarial tests (prompt injection suites) into CI

***Cloud and platform security***
---------------------------------

**Why Join Ema?**

description:

description:

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

**Job Description**

At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Lead Information Security Engineer** to be part of making this happen.

**Position Overview and Objective**

The **Lead Security Systems Engineer** is responsible for designing, implementing, and operating security capabilities that protect Arctic Wolf’s internal environment. This **role focuses on building and integrating security systems, combining off-the-shelf technologies with custom automation** to deliver scalable, reliable, and measurable security outcomes.

This is a hands-on engineering role that requires **strong systems thinking across operating systems, cloud platforms, identity, and networked environments.** The engineer will partner closely with Security Architecture and Engineering teams to translate strategy into practical, well-integrated solutions.

The role emphasizes depth in understanding how systems work, combined with the ability to extend and automate security controls through scripting and lightweight engineering.

**Responsibilities**

* **Implement and configure security technologies** (e.g., IAM, endpoint, SASE, vulnerability management)
* Develop **automation and integrations using scripting and APIs** to close functional gaps and improve scale
* **Extend vendor platforms** (e.g., Okta, Wiz, Prisma, etc.) to meet internal control requirements
* Translate **architectural patterns into real-world implementations** across endpoint, cloud, identity, and network environments
* Own services across their lifecycle: **build operate optimize retire**
* Improve interoperability between tools to create cohesive security capabilities
* **Reduce manual processes through automation** and reusable engineering patterns
* Work closely with IT, infrastructure, and application teams to embed security into systems and workflows
* Ensure solutions balance **security, usability, and operational efficiency**

* Provide input into tool selection based on system fit, integration capability, and scalability
* Evaluate vendor solutions and validate alignment with internal architecture

**Experience & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5 to 8 years of experience in **security engineering, systems engineering, or infrastructure engineering**
* Experience deploying and operating security technologies (e.g., IAM, EDR, network security, cloud security tools)
* Hands-on experience with **Linux system administration**
* Experience with **scripting/automation** to support system integration and operational efficiency

This role supports internal People Inc. employees by ensuring a seamless, efficient, and enjoyable end-user technology experience. * Strong scripting skills in PowerShell and shell (bash, zsh) for automation and system configuration.
* Experience interacting and developing with APIs.
* Experience managing virtual desktop infrastructures including Microsoft CloudPC, AWS Workspaces and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly convey technical information.

* Certification in modern desktop management (MD-101TOO-A) is preferred
* Certification in Jamf (Jamf 100, Jamf 200, Jamf 300, Jamf 400)

title: Data Solution Lead
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full-time Data Solution Lead (Group PMO Hub India) in Bangalore we’re looking for?

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your business analysis and data analytics expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and motivated teammates.

You'll play a key role in driving Alstom's digital transformation by enabling data-driven decision-making and delivering impactful analytics solutions. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as the Group PMO, Product Line Offices, Region Project Offices, and Talent/HR Management), lead stakeholder engagements to understand and deliver on business requirements, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of developing and maintaining Business Intelligence (BI) tools, such as Power BI, Qlik Sense, or Business Objects, and ensuring alignment with business objectives. You’ll also manage user access, specify and test enhancements, and oversee application upgrades.

We’ll look to you for:

* Engaging with stakeholders to collect, document, and prioritize business requirements for analytics and digital solutions.
* Designing and developing dashboards, reports, and analytics products to support fast decision-making by Project and Bid Managers.
* Collaborating with IS/IT partners to define data architecture and ensure accurate and reliable data sources.
* Facilitating requirements and design reviews to secure stakeholder alignment and feedback.
* Driving user-centric design principles to maximize usability and adoption of analytics solutions.
* Coordinating testing, business validation, user acceptance, and deployment readiness.
* Monitoring solution utilization and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Experience in business analysis, requirements management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Knowledge of Business Intelligence and Data Visualization platforms such as Power BI, Qlik Sense, or Tableau.
* Familiarity with data mapping, data quality principles, and reporting best practices.
* A certification in Business Analysis, Project Management, Data Analytics, Agile, or Scrum is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and organizational abilities.
  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
* Collaborate with diverse, transverse teams and supportive colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility.
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning programs.
* Progress towards broader leadership or technical roles within Alstom.
* Enjoy a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

  

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  

**Job Segment:** Business Analyst, Computer Science, Information Systems, Project Manager, Business Intelligence, Technology

title: IH Salesforce Production Support - Cigna Healthcare
description:
Technical Support Analyst
  
  
Position Information
  
  

* Job Title: Technical Support Analyst
* Function: Production Support / Salesforce Support
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Location: Bangalore
* Reports To: Cloud Support Manager

Role Purpose
  
  
The Technical Support Analyst is a hands-on member of the Production Support team, responsible for supporting and maintaining Salesforce applications used across Cigna International Health.
  
  
The primary focus of the role is day-to-day Salesforce administration across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, including user lifecycle management, access and permissions, declarative configuration, data maintenance, reporting, and operational support. The role also investigates and manages application incidents through ServiceNow, working with business users, technical teams, and senior support colleagues to restore service, meet agreed service levels, and provide a high standard of customer support.
  
The successful candidate will work with appropriate autonomy, prioritize their workload, and deliver accurate, controlled, and well-documented outcomes. They will escalate work requiring development, architecture decisions, elevated privileges, or higher-risk production changes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Salesforce Administration and User Access
  
  

* Create, update, activate, freeze, and deactivate Salesforce users in accordance with approved access requests and user lifecycle procedures.
* Maintain user access through profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, public groups, and other approved access mechanisms.
* Investigate and resolve common login, visibility, permission, object-access, field-access, and record-access issues.
* Maintain access hygiene by reviewing assignments, identifying inappropriate or obsolete access, and supporting periodic access reviews.
* Apply least-privilege and segregation-of-duties principles, escalating privileged, unusual, or high-risk access requests to the appropriate security, identity-management, or senior Salesforce resource.
* Maintain clear evidence of approvals and completed access changes where required for audit or control purposes.

Declarative Configuration and Platform Maintenance
  
  

* Configure and maintain Salesforce using approved declarative, “clicks-not-code” capabilities.
* Support routine changes to standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, queues, assignment rules, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and other administrative configurations.
* Assist with basic Salesforce Flow configuration and troubleshooting where the requirement is within the role’s approved administrative scope.
* Perform configuration and operational support across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud.
* Validate changes in an appropriate lower environment before production implementation, following established testing, approval, deployment, and post-implementation validation procedures.
* Monitor the impact of routine Salesforce releases and support low-risk readiness or validation activities.
* Escalate requirements involving Apex, Lightning Web Components, complex integrations, architecture changes, or development-intensive solutions.

Data Maintenance and Reporting
  
  

* Maintain Salesforce data accurately and securely, including approved record creation, updates, corrections, ownership changes, and controlled bulk activities.
* Support data imports, exports, and mass updates using authorized tools and documented procedures.
* Complete appropriate validation and reconciliation before and after data changes.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, obsolete, or inconsistent information and work with data owners to improve data quality.
* Create and maintain standard reports and dashboards to support operational and business requirements.
* Protect sensitive information and avoid unapproved data deletion, extraction, or other high-risk data activity.
* Maintain traceable records of approvals, test results, data files, outcomes, and rollback information where required.

Incident and Application Support
  
  

* Monitor and manage incidents and support requests assigned through ServiceNow.
* Review ticket information, confirm the reported symptoms and business impact, and gather any additional information required to investigate the issue.
* Validate that the correct application or configuration item is recorded and ensure the incident is assigned to the appropriate support group.
* Investigate common Salesforce and supported application issues, including user access, permissions, configuration, data, workflow, and functional errors.
* Reproduce issues where appropriate, review available documentation and known issues, and identify a resolution, workaround, or appropriate escalation path.
* Maintain accurate ticket states and remain aware of applicable responses and resolution of SLAs.
* Record meaningful internal investigation details, actions taken, dependencies, and escalation of information in work notes.
* Provide clear and timely customer updates through the appropriate customer-visible ServiceNow fields.
* Reassign incidents promptly when another team is required, documenting the reason for reassignment.
* Complete accurate resolution information and clear resolution notes before resolving a ticket.
* Escalate major, high-impact, recurring, security-related, or technically complex incidents in accordance with established support procedures.

Documentation, Automation, and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Create and maintain clear operational documentation, runbooks, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Identify repetitive, manual, or error-prone activities that may be suitable for controlled automation.
* Contribute to the design, testing, documentation, and ongoing monitoring of low-risk automation solutions.
* Recommend improvements that increase support efficiency, data quality, customer experience, control effectiveness, or service reliability.

Collaboration and Customer Service
  
  

* Work effectively with geographically distributed colleagues across business, production support, identity and access management, security, product, engineering, and development teams.
* Translate technical issues into clear, practical information for both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Manage assigned work with appropriate autonomy, balancing priorities, risk, business impact, and SLA commitments.
* Provide accurate, professional, and customer-focused communication throughout requests and incidents.
* Seek guidance when requirements are unclear and escalate promptly when an issue exceeds the role’s authority or technical scope.

Required Skills and Experience
  
  

* Minimum of three years of professional experience working as a Salesforce Administrator.
* Practical administration experience across:
* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Experience Cloud
* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce user provisioning, deactivation, access management, profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, and public groups.
* Experience configuring standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, validation rules, assignment rules, reports, and dashboards.
* Experience with declarative Salesforce administration and basic Flow configuration or troubleshooting.
* Experience performing controlled data imports, exports, corrections, bulk updates, and data-quality activities.
* Demonstrated experience supporting production applications and investigating user, access, configuration, data, and functional issues.
* Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation, ticket records, change evidence, and audit trails.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to security, data protection, operational risk, and change control.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to prioritize assigned work, work independently within defined procedures, and recognize when escalation is required.

Preferred or Desirable Skills
  
  

* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, including incident handling, work notes, customer updates, resolution information, and SLA awareness.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.
* Experience supporting Salesforce in a health insurance, healthcare or other regulated environment.
* Experience with access reviews, audit evidence, segregation-of-duties controls, or identity and access management processes.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, Jira, Confluence, knowledge management, release-readiness activities, user acceptance testing, and smoke testing.
* Exposure to application-monitoring or log-analysis tools such as Dynatrace or Splunk.
* Experience identifying opportunities to automate recurring administrative or support activities.

Behaviors and Competencies
  
  

* Customer focused: Provides responsive, accurate, and professional support.
* Team player: Collaborates openly across geographic, business, and technical boundaries.
* Problem solver: Investigates methodically and uses evidence to reach sound conclusions.
* Autonomous: Takes ownership of assigned work while escalating appropriately.
* Process minded: Follows documented controls and maintains complete, traceable records.
* Security and risk aware: Protects access, data, system stability, and audit integrity.
* Curious and adaptable: Learns unfamiliar applications and business processes confidently.
* Continuous-improvement driven: Challenges inefficient manual processes and proposes safe, practical improvements.
* Clear communicator: Explains technical matters effectively to different audiences.
* Dependable: Manages priorities and delivers work to agreed time and quality expectations.

Scope of the Role
  
  
This is primarily a Salesforce administration and production-support position, not a Salesforce developer or solution-architect role. The analyst is expected to complete routine declarative configuration and operational support independently within approved procedures. Custom development, complex integration work, architecture decisions, privileged actions, and high-risk production changes must be referred to the appropriate senior administrator, engineering, architecture, security, or development team.
  
Measures of Success
  
  
**Success in the position will be demonstrated through:**  

* Timely and accurate completion of user lifecycle and access requests.
* Achievement of applicable incident and request SLAs.
* High-quality investigation notes, customer communications, and resolution records.
* Secure, accurate, and controlled Salesforce configuration and data maintenance.
* Complete change, approval, testing, and audit evidence.
* Effective escalation of work outside administrative scope.
* Current, usable operational documentation and knowledge articles.
* Measurable contribution to automation, process improvement, and reduced recurring support efforts.

About The Cigna Group
  
  
Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: Data Design and Delivery Specialist
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

You'll play a key role in driving Alstom's digital transformation by enabling data-driven decision-making and delivering impactful analytics solutions. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as the Group PMO, Product Line Offices, Region Project Offices, and Talent/HR Management), lead stakeholder engagements to understand and deliver on business requirements, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of developing and maintaining Business Intelligence (BI) tools, such as Power BI, Qlik Sense, or Business Objects, and ensuring alignment with business objectives. You’ll also manage user access, specify and test enhancements, and oversee application upgrades.

* Driving user-centric design principles to maximize usability and adoption of analytics solutions.
* Coordinating testing, business validation, user acceptance, and deployment readiness.
* Monitoring solution utilization and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

* Experience in business analysis, requirements management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Knowledge of Business Intelligence and Data Visualization platforms such as Power BI, Qlik Sense, or Tableau.
* Familiarity with data mapping, data quality principles, and reporting best practices.

* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills.

* Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
* Collaborate with diverse, transverse teams and supportive colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility.
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning programs.
* Progress towards broader leadership or technical roles within Alstom.

title: Data Integration Engineer (Senior Associate)
description:
* Job ID: 916314
