### **Role description**

Grant Thornton INDUS is the in-house offshore center for Grant Thornton US- a member firm of Grant Thornton International, with offices in Bangalore and Kolkata. Our team of over 2,400 professionals specializes in Tax, Audit, Advisory, Operations, and Enabling functions, delivering exceptional client service, and driving excellence across all domains. We are proud to have been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the last two consecutive years, reflecting our commitment to building a high-trust, high-performance culture. At Grant Thornton INDUS, our people-centric culture is rooted in empowering individuals, bold leadership, and a commitment to providing distinctive client experiences. We foster a transparent, competitive, and performance-driven environment where professionals are given opportunities to contribute to meaningful and impactful initiatives. Our young and dynamic workforce not only excels in delivering business outcomes but also inspires and gives back to the community through generous and impactful service initiatives.

**Why Join Grant Thornton INDUS?**

* **Empowered Environment:** We encourage autonomy and bold decision-making at all levels, shaping our future together.
* **Significant Contributions:** We provide ample opportunities to deliver transformational results and exceptional client service, driving innovation and growth.
* **Culture of Excellence:** We promote transparency, competitiveness, and a relentless drive to excel.
* **Learning Opportunities:** We offer diverse, multi-platform learning opportunities for dynamic growth.
* **Vibrant Culture:** Our open culture fosters diversity, acceptance, engagement, and enjoyment for all.
* **Community Impact:** We support initiatives that enable employees to make meaningful contributions to society and make a wider difference.

**Summary**

Grant Thornton GTech’s Data & Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization’s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption.

* Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns.

* Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation).

* Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption.

* Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders.

* Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs.

* Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers.

* Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets.

* Optimize Snowflake queries, models, and transformations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.

* Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation.

* Apply governance-by-design practices (access, classification/metadata, certified datasets), and mentor and guide more junior team members.

**Skills**

* Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing.

* Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics.

* Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct & optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis & troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams & Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets.

* Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers.

* Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance).

* Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement).

* Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

* Strong understanding of data lineage, metadata traceability, and impact analysis.

* Experience applying governance-by-design and data observability (data quality tests, lineage, and certified datasets).

* Effective communication skills with ability to work directly with business stakeholders.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science (BS) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

* 5+ years of analytics engineering, BI/data warehouse development, or related data experience in enterprise data environments.

* Preferred: Experience in professional services, accounting industry, or client service/consultative technology roles.

* Experience with ETL/ELT tools (Informatica, dbt).

* Experience with BI/reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Excel).

* Experience with data modeling methodologies (Dimensional modeling, Data Marts, Data Warehousing, Star/Snowflake schema).

* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

* Agile/Scrum delivery exposure.

**Grant Thornton INDUS (Full-Time Employee) Benefits:**

* **Insurance:** Health, Accidental, and Term Life Insurance for employees (and dependents as applicable).
* **Wellness:** Employee Assistance Program, Corporate Health Plans, Gym (Bangalore), Wellness Webinars, Health months.
* **Work-Life Balance:** Hybrid work model, flexible work options for returning mothers.
* **Parental Support:** Maternity/Paternity leave, daycare facilities, flexible work arrangements.
* **Mobility:** Secondment opportunities, relocation benefits, internal job postings.
* **Retirement:** Provident Fund, Gratuity, Leave Encashment, National Pension Scheme.
* **Additional Benefits:** Women’s security (night transport), home office setup allowance, certification reimbursements, meal cards, appreciation holidays, service awards.
* **Learning:** Multi-channelIn-house learning platform, LinkedIn Learning, certification programs.

  

**About Grant Thornton INDUS**
------------------------------

Grant Thornton INDUS is the global capability center for Grant Thornton US, the U.S. member firm of Grant Thornton International Ltd., a leading global network of independent audit, tax, and advisory firms. Founded in Chicago in 1924, Grant Thornton US is one of the leading accounting and advisory firms in the U.S., bringing together $4B+ in revenue, 56 U.S. offices, and a multi-national platform spanning 20 countries with 25,000 people. It combines deep expertise, advanced technology, and a collaborative mindset to help clients solve complex challenges and grow with confidence. Since 2012, Grant Thornton INDUS has brought together 3,300+ professionals across Tax, Audit, Advisory, Client Services, Innovation, and Enabling Functions to deliver high-impact solutions for Grant Thornton US and its global network. Recognized as a Great Place To Work® for three consecutive years and among India’s Top 15 Best Workplaces™ in Professional Services 2026, INDUS offers a high-performance culture where people are trusted, supported, and empowered to grow.

title: Senior Information Security Analyst
description:
**Company Description**

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 62,000 staff across a network of more than 1000 independent companies in over 62 countries and operating more than 900 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6.515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

 **Job Description**

**Senior Information Security Analyst – Service Delivery Management**  
  
**REPORTING TO: IT Security Coordinator**  
**REPORTING LOCATION: Bangalore**  
**WORKING LOCATION: Bangalore**  
**SHIFT TIMINGS: 12PM - 9PM IST**  
**MODE OF WORK: Hybrid**

**SUMMARY OF ROLE AND OBJECTIVES:**

The Service Delivery Management, Metrics & Onboardings crew actively participates in managing the delivery of the Security Services to internal service consumers.

The Information Security Analyst (Service Delivery Management, Metrics & Onboardings) is responsible for service management activities for assigned service consumer base, acting as the SPOC (Single Point of Contact) between the service consumers and the Eurofins Group Security, resulting in positive customer satisfaction.

From operational perspective, the Information Security Analyst is responsible for the health of security services for internal service consumers.

**ROLE & OBJECTIVES**:

**Specific Assignments:**

The main responsibilities of an Information Security Analyst (Service Delivery Management, Metrics & Onboardings)

Role responsibilities:

* Run all Service Delivery processes and ITSM processes in Security Operations as defined by the Group.
* Manage and/or oversee the overall Security Services onboarding program for Zones and non-integrated ELEs, including but not limited to set deployment expectations, build project timeline, Onboarding resources management, stream communication across different stakeholders, monitor and report progress, and propose roadblock removal strategies so a compliance metric for a minimum of 95% of all Security Toolset coverage is achieved for all technologies in scope (100% for SIEM).
* Ensure Security Services are fit for purpose, carrying out relevant reviews/propose modifications as necessary.
* Conduct Security Service Review sessions with service consumers and stakeholders with special attention to Onboarding, Security Toolset compliance and Security Service Dashboards.
* Cooperate with internal Security teams and other Security actors to further develop Security Operations.
* Report SLA, KPI and performance metrics of Security Services, steer activities as per metrics defined in the Service card.
* Make sure definition of improvement plans to meet SLA and KPI are in place.
* Assess and report the level of compliance for each ELE/ZONE; and ensure there is a defined plan to reach the target as defined in the TSFs.
* Coordinate the work provided and service delivered by the security partners.
* Prepare and publish the report to stakeholders including Local IT Management and Information Security Management.
* Ensure that all Security documentation for Internal/External service consumers are available and updated.
* Help in the development of processes and procedures required for the delivery of the Security Services.
* Provide a clear and regular update to service consumers on action items, including proposed actions and dates to closure.
* Receive and coordinate reporting requests, assisting with high level design of reports where required.
* Provide Security Services expectations to align the stakeholders and service consumers.

Other Assignments:

* Overall accountability for transition success building best practices for the service management community.
* Build, manage and maintain a trusted relationship with all Security actors and service consumers both internally and externally.
* Organizing and Leading Service Delivery sessions including incident review, problem resolution, etc.
* Leverage the most effective and efficient service from the delivery teams for each assigned service consumer.
* Receive and coordinate consumer reported bugs/issues with internal Security Team.
* Maintain/track service consumers contact and organization details.
* Produce consistent, high quality service reviews on a monthly basis that demonstrate quality and continuous improvement.
* Escalation point for internal teams for unresponsive service consumers.
* Provide feedback to the Service Owner
* Supports the Lead Information Security Consultant and the associate Director in day-to-day activities.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

Education and Certifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, IT, or a related field. **(required)**
* Relevant certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA Security +, CISM, or similar credentials are preferred.

Professional Experience:

* Minimum of 3+ years of experience in IT service delivery.
* Demonstrated experience working in a security-focused organization or environment.

------------------------

DLP Triage & Processing · Own the end-to-end triage lifecycle for DLP alerts across endpoints, cloud environments (M365, Google Workspace, AWS), and email — from initial alert review through disposition and escalation. · Classify and prioritize incidents by sensitivity, intent, and potential business impact; apply consistent triage frameworks to ensure efficient and defensible case handling. · Identify policy gaps, false-positive patterns, and emerging exfiltration vectors; recommend DLP policy refinements to reduce risk while minimizing friction for legitimate business activities. · Maintain accurate, timely case records in the case management system, ensuring chain-of-custody integrity for all evidence. Investigations · Lead and conduct end-to-end investigations of potential insider risk incidents — including IP theft, data exfiltration, policy violations, sabotage, and pre-departure data staging. · Collect, preserve, and analyze digital evidence from endpoint forensics, cloud storage, communication platforms, and HR systems in accordance with legal and evidentiary standards. · Produce comprehensive, well-structured investigation reports documenting findings, timelines, impact assessments, and recommended actions suitable for legal, HR, and executive audiences. · Manage multiple concurrent active investigations with rigor, discretion, and appropriate urgency. Subject Interviews · Plan and conduct structured subject interviews in coordination with Legal, HR, and business leadership — applying established interview methodologies tailored to insider risk contexts (e.g., cognitive interviewing, motivational interviewing). · Conduct witness interviews to gather corroborating information and context; document findings with accuracy and impartiality. · Maintain composure and objectivity in sensitive, adversarial, or emotionally charged interview settings; protect subject dignity while gathering actionable intelligence. Legal Collaboration & Case Adjudication · Partner closely with Legal and Employment Law to ensure investigations comply with applicable labor laws, privacy regulations, and evidentiary standards across all operating jurisdictions (U.S., India, Israel, EU, and Asia-Pacific). · Present investigation findings, evidence packages, and risk assessments to Legal and HR for case adjudication — including decisions on disciplinary action, civil litigation, criminal referral, or administrative closure. · Support the preparation of materials for regulatory inquiries, litigation holds, and law enforcement cooperation when required. · Track and document case dispositions and lessons learned to continuously improve program policy and legal defensibility. Threat Intelligence & Risk Program Development · Develop and maintain an insider threat intelligence capability — tracking threat actor TTPs relevant to the semiconductor industry, including economic espionage, nation-state recruitment, and supply chain manipulation. · Produce threat intelligence products (briefings, advisories, risk reports) for security leadership, HR, and business unit heads to inform enterprise risk decisions. · Monitor the external threat landscape, including geopolitical developments, export control changes, and industry-specific threat reporting from CISA, FBI, and

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Skill Requirement :** Required · 7+ years of progressive experience in insider threat, corporate investigations, counterintelligence, digital forensics, or a closely related security discipline. · Demonstrated expertise with DLP platforms (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Symantec DLP, Forcepoint, Zscaler) including policy tuning, triage workflows, and incident adjudication. · Proficiency with SIEM platforms (XSIAM, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or equivalent) and UEBA/UAM tools for behavioral analysis and anomaly detection. · Hands-on experience conducting complex civil or corporate investigations — from initial tip through evidence collection, interviews, reporting, and legal referral. · Experience conducting structured subject interviews and witness interviews in a corporate or law enforcement context. · Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Legal, HR, IT, and senior leadership in a highly confidential environment. · Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical audiences. · Demonstrated knowledge of applicable privacy and employment laws across multiple jurisdictions (particularly U.S., EU GDPR, and Asia-Pacific regimes). · Hands-on experience operating AI-powered insider risk or UEBA platforms — including use case configuration, cohort/module development, and risk score tuning — with a clear understanding of how AI-assisted detection outputs translate into investigation workflows. Preferred · Prior experience in the semiconductor, defense technology, or critical technology sectors with heightened awareness of IP protection. · Experience in or with federal law enforcement, intelligence community, or military counterintelligence. · Background in threat intelligence production (STIX/TAXII, indicator management, adversary TTP analysis). · Familiarity with digital forensic tools (EnCase, FTK, Cellebrite, or equivalent) and e-discovery platforms. · Experience with SOAR platforms and automation of investigation workflows. · Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK; for Enterprise and Insider Threat frameworks. · Experience using generative AI / LLM tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar) to accelerate investigative analysis, summarize case evidence, draft reports, or build detection logic. · Familiarity with the ethical, legal, and governance considerations of deploying AI in a workforce monitoring context, including explainability requirements and bias mitigation. Education & Certifications · Bachelor\'s degree in Cybersecurity, Criminal Justice, Intelligence Studies, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree a plus. · Relevant professional certifications valued: CISSP, CISM, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CFCE, EnCE, CCITP (CERT Insider Threat Professional), or equivalent.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

**Other Requirement :** You think like an investigator AND a data analyst — equally comfortable in a boardroom briefing and deep in SIEM query language. You harness AI as a force multiplier — you know how to configure detection use cases, build meaningful cohorts, and tune behavioral modules without losing sight of the human judgment that makes investigations defensible. You operate with impeccable judgment and discretion — you understand that access to sensitive data and AI-assisted monitoring is a privilege with strict ethical obligations. You are proactive, not reactive — you identify and reduce risk before incidents occur. You build trust across organizational boundaries — Legal trusts your evidence, HR trusts your process, and business leaders trust your judgment. You thrive in ambiguity and complexity — insider risk rarely comes neatly packaged, and you know how to structure uncertainty into defensible conclusions.

* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Guidewire Cloud (PolicyCenter on Guidewire Cloud Platform), including cloud-native patterns, observability, and CI/CD practices.

* Familiarity with other Guidewire products (ClaimCenter, BillingCenter, Analytics, or Data Platform) and with modern microservices or event-driven architectures.
* BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

---------------

We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will take architectural ownership of one or more complex PolicyCenter implementations, aligning solution designs with customer business objectives while embedding Professional Services’ priorities around AI-enabled, faster, and more predictable delivery.

  
  

You will define technical roadmaps, guide teams through critical design and integration decisions, and put in place patterns and assets that measurably reduce implementation effort and time for future projects. As your influence grows, you will help customers fully leverage Guidewire’s cloud and AI platform, directly supporting our wider mission to transform how the world’s P&C insurers do business and advancing Guidewire’s ambition to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions globally.

Flexible work environment.
  
Health and wellness benefits.
  
Paid time off programs including volunteer time off.
  
Market‑competitive pay and incentive programs.

All roles at Guidewire include an in‑person interview experience, and we provide an in‑person orientation for all new hires to help you build relationships and understand how your work contributes to our customers and mission.

title: Associate HRIS Analyst, Workday Operations
description:
Join our Global Workforce Systems team as an Associate HRIS Analyst, Workday Operations and quickly expand your Workday knowledge through hands-on experience. You will manage JIRA tickets, process routine Workday transactions, maintain accurate employee data, and support process documentation. We are looking for someone with one to two years of Workday experience who is curious, careful, and committed to delivering accurate results.  
  
This is a regular, full-time position based in Bangalore, India and requires a work schedule that provides coverage during core U.S. business hours.

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the first level of review and support for HRIS and Workday requests submitted through JIRA, ensuring requests are acknowledged, assessed, and appropriately routed.
* Support the day-to-day management of the JIRA ticket queue by reviewing new tickets, prioritizing routine requests according to established guidelines, monitoring aging items, updating statuses, and following up as needed.
* Evaluate incoming tickets for completeness, urgency, business impact, dependencies, and appropriate next steps.
* Resolve routine Workday questions, requests, transactions, and data issues using established procedures and documented solutions.
* Proactively request missing information or clarification when a ticket does not contain sufficient details to investigate or complete the request accurately.
* Escalate complex, high-risk, time-sensitive, or unresolved issues to the appropriate HRIS team member with clear documentation of the issue, troubleshooting performed, supporting information, and recommended next steps.
* Maintain complete and timely JIRA documentation, including the original request, investigation performed, actions taken, stakeholder communication, decisions, and final resolution.
* Monitor open tickets and dependencies and proactively follow up when information, approvals, testing, or action is outstanding.
* Identify tickets at risk of missing established service expectations or deadlines and escalate appropriately.
* Complete assigned routine Workday transactions and employee data updates across the employee lifecycle, according to established procedures, approval requirements, and role-based access.
* Review source documentation and validate key information, including employee names, dates, organizations, positions, statuses, and other relevant data, before completing Workday transactions.
* Perform post-transaction quality checks and follow documented validation steps to confirm that changes were processed accurately, escalating unexpected results or potential downstream impacts.
* Research employee and HRIS data discrepancies, reconcile information between source documentation and Workday, resolve routine issues, and escalate exceptions when necessary.
* Support Workday testing for system updates, enhancements, fixes, and configuration changes, including executing test scripts, validating expected results, documenting defects, and tracking issues through resolution.
* Assist with documenting and maintaining HRIS workflows and process maps, including process steps, responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, process guides, job aids, user instructions, FAQs, and HRIS knowledge articles to improve consistency and reduce repeat questions.
* Review existing workflows and documentation periodically to ensure they remain accurate and aligned with current Workday functionality and business processes.
* Identify recurring tickets, data issues, bottlenecks, or manual processes and share observations and potential improvement opportunities with the HRIS team.
* Support routine data audits, reconciliations, and validation activities to maintain HRIS data integrity.
* Prepare, send, track, and validate manual HR notifications, ensuring communications are accurate, timely, and sent to the appropriate recipients.
* Partner collaboratively with Talent & Culture (HR), Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, IT, and other stakeholders as necessary to investigate and resolve HRIS requests.
* Handle employee and organizational data in accordance with established privacy, confidentiality, and information-security requirements.

**What You Bring**

* 1–2 years of experience supporting Workday within HR, HRIS, People Operations, Shared Services, or a similar environment.
* Hands-on experience reviewing or processing employee data and transactions in Workday.
* Experience using JIRA or a comparable ticket/case-management platform, including reviewing, assigning, prioritizing, documenting, tracking, escalating, and resolving support requests.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a ticket queue independently, balance competing priorities, and follow requests through to resolution.
* Experience creating or maintaining workflows, process documentation, SOPs, job aids, or knowledge articles.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify missing, inconsistent, or potentially inaccurate information.
* A proactive approach to work, including the ability to identify outstanding actions, anticipate potential issues, and follow up without waiting for direction.
* Strong problem-solving and investigative skills with the judgment to distinguish between issues that can be resolved independently and those requiring escalation.
* Ability to follow detailed procedures while recognizing opportunities to improve existing processes.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tickets, recurring responsibilities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical or process-related information in a way that is understandable to different audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders across teams, locations, and time zones.
* Ability to appropriately handle confidential employee and organizational information.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**SAP Security, GRC Access Control and Identity Management Specialist**

Professional Job Description for Modern SAP Landscapes

Scope: SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BW and integrated SAP platforms

**Role Type** : SAP Security, GRC, IDM and Access Governance

**Seniority** : Senior Analyst / Consultant / Specialist / Lead, depending on experience

**Primary Focus** : User access management, role lifecycle, GRC operations, IDM provisioning, risk ruleset management, audits and access reviews

**Landscape** : SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC AC/PC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and related integrations

  

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced SAP Security, GRC and Identity Access Management professional to manage end-to-end SAP user access, role design, identity lifecycle, access governance, emergency access, risk analysis, audits and security operations across a complex SAP landscape. The role will support SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC Access Control, SAP GRC Process Control, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, SAP Ariba, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and other integrated SAP applications.

The candidate will be responsible for SAP user management, SAP role design and maintenance, GRC operations, access risk analysis, SAP Firefighter governance, user access review implementation, quarterly access reviews, risk ruleset management, SoD remediation support, country rollouts, SAP native security assessments and audit support. The role requires strong process discipline, documentation quality and audit-ready execution across run, change and project activities.

  

**Key Accountability Areas**

**Area - Expected Ownership**

* **SAP User Access Management** : Create, modify, maintain and revoke SAP user access using approved access request, provisioning and governance processes.
* **SAP Role Management** : Own role requirement gathering, role design, build, testing, transport, go-live and ongoing maintenance.
* **SAP GRC Access Control** : Administer GRC Access Control processes across ARA, EAM, ARM and access governance workflows.
* **SAP GRC Process Control** : Support quarterly CCM updates, control monitoring, exception validation and control evidence management.
* **SAP IDM** : Manage identity lifecycle workflows, provisioning, deprovisioning, reconciliation and connector issue resolution.
* **Access Reviews and Audits** : Implement and operate user access reviews, firefighter reviews, audit evidence packs and remediation tracking.
* **Risk Ruleset Management** : Design, maintain, test and govern SoD and critical access rulesets for SAP and integrated applications.
* **SAP Native Security** : Assess SAP authorization, user, privileged access, RFC, technical user and security configuration risks.

  

**Detailed Responsibilities**

* **SAP User Access Management**
  + Manage SAP user ID creation, modification, lock, unlock, validity updates, role assignment, termination and periodic user maintenance across SAP systems.
  + Support access provisioning and deprovisioning through SAP IDM and SAP GRC Access Control workflows.
  + Handle access requests, emergency requests, weekend releases and production access support activities.
  + Ensure access is provisioned based on approved requests, business need, least privilege and segregation of duties requirements.
  + Maintain user master data, license-relevant user classifications, technical users, communication users and validity controls.
* **SAP Role Management**
  + Design, build, test and maintain SAP security roles for SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW, Fiori, BTP integrations and related SAP platforms.
  + Perform role requirement gathering with business process owners, functional teams, control owners and country rollout teams.
  + Translate business requirements into authorization concepts, role matrices, derived roles, composite roles and Fiori catalogs, groups, spaces or pages.
  + Own the role lifecycle from requirement gathering, design, build and unit testing through UAT, defect remediation, transport movement, go-live and hypercare.
  + Support role redesign, role cleanup, SoD reduction, access optimization and country-specific role rollout activities.
* **SAP GRC Access Control Management**
  + Administer SAP GRC Access Control modules including Access Risk Analysis, Emergency Access Management, Access Request Management and Business Role Management where applicable.
  + Configure and support GRC workflows, approval paths, request types, provisioning settings, connectors and access request exceptions.
  + Perform access risk analysis for users, roles, access requests and role changes.
  + Monitor and resolve GRC provisioning failures, workflow issues, connector errors and control exceptions.
  + Support integrated access governance across SAP S/4HANA, BW, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BTP and other connected applications.
* **SAP GRC ARA and Risk Ruleset Management**
  + Manage SAP GRC ARA risk analysis for users, roles, profiles, critical transactions and sensitive authorization combinations.
  + Design, update and maintain SAP risk rulesets including risks, functions, actions, permissions and mitigating controls.
  + Perform ruleset impact assessment, regression testing and approval tracking before production deployment.
  + Coordinate SoD risk remediation, mitigation control assignment and risk owner sign-off.
  + Maintain ruleset documentation, change history, test evidence and version control.
* **SAP Firefighter and Emergency Access Management**
  + Manage SAP Firefighter ID setup, owner assignment, controller assignment, reason codes and emergency access configuration.
  + Support emergency access request, approval, usage monitoring, log review and closure processes.
  + Perform SAP GRC Firefighter log reviews and coordinate timely controller review and sign-off.
  + Investigate unauthorized, excessive or inappropriate firefighter usage and track remediation actions.
  + Maintain audit-ready evidence for firefighter assignment, usage, review, exceptions and approvals.
* **SAP User Access Review Implementation and Quarterly Reviews**
  + Implement SAP user access review campaigns using SAP GRC or approved access certification tools.
  + Prepare user, role, critical access, SoD, privileged access and firefighter review datasets.
  + Coordinate quarterly access reviews with managers, role owners, process owners and control owners.
  + Track review completion, access retention, revocation, exceptions, remediation actions and management approvals.
  + Maintain complete evidence for internal audit, external audit and compliance reporting.
* **SAP GRC Process Control and Quarterly CCM Updates**
  + Support SAP GRC Process Control operations, control mapping, monitoring rules and issue tracking.
  + Perform quarterly Continuous Control Monitoring updates based on process, configuration, risk and control changes.
  + Maintain CCM business rules, monitoring schedules, exception logic and control owner assignments.
  + Coordinate with process owners to validate CCM exceptions, control failures and remediation actions.
  + Prepare control evidence, deficiency documentation and management reporting.
* **SAP IDM and Identity Lifecycle Management**
  + Manage identity lifecycle processes in SAP IDM including joiner, mover, leaver, role assignment, provisioning and deprovisioning workflows.
  + Support integrations between SAP IDM, HR source systems, SAP GRC, SAP systems and downstream applications.
  + Maintain IDM workflows, connectors, provisioning rules, approval logic and reconciliation processes.
  + Troubleshoot provisioning failures, access synchronization issues and identity data inconsistencies.
  + Support future-state IAM planning involving SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP IAG or enterprise identity platforms where applicable.
* **Country Rollouts and Release Support**
  + Support SAP security activities for new country rollouts, company code rollouts, business process deployments and regional templates.
  + Gather local access requirements and align them with global role design, control standards and SoD requirements.
  + Prepare access matrices, role mapping, test scripts, cutover plans and go-live readiness evidence.
  + Support unit testing, UAT, defect resolution, transport movement, weekend release and hypercare activities.
  + Ensure country-specific access is secure, approved, tested and audit-ready before production use.
* **SAP Native Security Assessment and Audit Support**
  + Perform SAP native security assessments across S/4HANA, ECC, BW, GRC, Solution Manager, BTP-integrated applications and other SAP platforms.
  + Review SAP authorization objects, critical transactions, privileged users, RFC users, communication users, generic IDs and sensitive access.
  + Identify excessive access, weak role design, unused roles, shared IDs, control gaps and configuration weaknesses.
  + Support SAP internal audit, external audit, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
  + Prepare audit evidence packs, management responses, remediation plans and closure validation evidence.

**SAP Application Scope**

* SAP S/4HANA on RISE / Private Cloud Edition
* SAP GRC Access Control
* SAP GRC Process Control
* SAP IDM
* SAP BTP
* SAP Ariba
* SAP SuccessFactors
* SAP BW / BW4HANA
* SAP Fiori Launchpad
* SAP Solution Manager
* SAP Cloud Identity Services / IAS / IPS, where applicable
* Integrated non-SAP systems connected to SAP access governance

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP Security, SAP GRC Access Control and SAP user administration.
* Experience in SAP role design, role build, UAT support, transport movement and production deployment.
* Working knowledge of SAP GRC ARA, EAM, ARM and risk ruleset management.
* Experience with SAP Firefighter ID management, log review and emergency access governance.
* Experience implementing and operating SAP user access reviews and quarterly access certification processes.
* Experience with SAP IDM provisioning, workflows, connectors and identity lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA security, Fiori security, authorization objects and business role concepts.
* Understanding of SAP GRC Process Control and Continuous Control Monitoring.
* Experience supporting SAP internal audits, external audits, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, evidence management and issue resolution skills.

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA on RISE or hybrid SAP cloud landscapes.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP security, role collections, identity provider integration and cloud authorization concepts.
* Experience with SAP Ariba and SAP SuccessFactors access governance.
* Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services, IAS, IPS, SAP IAG or Microsoft Entra ID integration.
* Awareness of cross-application SoD risks across SAP and cloud applications.
* Experience in global SAP template rollouts and country-specific security deployments.
* Knowledge of SOX, ITGC, NIST, ISO 27001 or internal control frameworks.

title: Analyst Technology Risk Intelligence
description:
**Analyst Technology Risk Intelligence**
========================================

Req ID: 124056
Department: Chief Information Risk Office
Division: Risk

**About Us**
------------

  

**Standard**  

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

  


As an Analyst, Technology Risk Intelligence in our Risk, Group Technology team, you’ll support the Technology Risk Intelligence practice to provide day\-to\-day analyst support to by assisting with repeatable data, reporting and evidence routines that help the team deliver Line 2 oversight.

  

Working under the supervision of Senior Associates/Managers to gather and organise evidence, extract and reconcile data, you’ll refresh dashboards and prepare draft summaries that support reviews, thematic work, events/issues analysis and governance packs.

  

You’ll contribute to efficiency and repeatability by maintaining and running approved templates, scripts and automation steps (where authorised), escalating data quality issues and tool/access concerns promptly, and ensuring all outputs are quality\-checked and reviewed before use in governance.

  



Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  


**Role Type: Permanent**  

**Role Location: Bengaluru**  

**Work Hours: 7 AM to 4 PM**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

  

As an Analyst Technology Risk Intelligence, you will:

  


* Assisting with delivery of assigned tasks for prioritised insight routines and use\-cases by following defined procedures, checklists and templates
* Extracting, cleaning and reconciling data from approved sources, maintaining working files used for repeatable insight routines
* Refreshing dashboards and reporting packs by updating datasets, running refresh steps and completing quality checks, escalating anomalies before distribution
* Assisting with maintenance of approved automation (where authorized) by running scheduled steps, updating parameters and logging outcomes; escalating failures and access/tool issues promptly
* Support stakeholder requests by gathering data and evidence, documenting assumptions, ensuring traceability to source information, and assisting with governance pack preparation, including data compilation, formatting, proofreading, and draft narrative development
* Assisting with thematic reviews and events/issues analysis by collating data and evidence, preparing draft summaries and supporting basic trend/exceptions analysis under supervision
* Supporting uplift tracking routines (e.g., PACT\-aligned measures) by updating trackers, compiling evidence and preparing draft updates for review
* Operating as a developing analyst, building capability in data handling, dashboarding, documentation and risk concepts through coaching and on\-the\-job learning
**What will you bring?**
------------------------

  

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:


* Experience (or demonstrated capability) in an analyst/support role involving data, reporting, operations, risk, assurance or technology within a complex environment
* Basic analytical skills: ability to extract, organise and reconcile data and identify exceptions for review
* Exposure to reporting tools (e.g., Excel and/or Power BI) and ability to follow defined refresh and QA steps
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline, including evidence referencing and version control
* Clear written communication skills to draft simple summaries and status updates for review
* Tertiary qualifications (or working toward) in a relevant discipline (data/analytics, technology, cyber security, engineering, risk, or business/finance)

  


**Good to have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**


* Awareness of technology and cyber risk concepts and common control practices
* Exposure to basic automation (e.g., Excel Power Query) and/or simple scripting (SQL/Python) in a governed environment
* Experience maintaining trackers, logs and evidence packs for governance, audit or assurance activities

  



You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

  


ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  



We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

System Reliability \& DevOps: Package services with Docker, automate routine deployment workflows with shell scripting (Bash), and maintain CI/CD pipelines.


Collaboration \& Code Quality: Participate in design reviews, maintain code documentation, and write unit and integration tests to ensure enterprise\-grade stability and security.

  

  

**Required skills** :


A. TypeScript / JavaScript \& Client\-Side Development

Cloud Spanner: Familiarity or hands\-on experience working with distributed relational databases, particularly Google Cloud Spanner (schema design, query performance tuning, primary keys, interleaved tables).


D. Cloud Infrastructure (GCP) \& DevOps


GCP Services: Hands\-on familiarity with core Google Cloud Platform products, notably Cloud Run (serverless container orchestration) and Artifact Registry (container image management).

Trane Technologies is seeking a Data Engineering Analyst to join our ISC Data Architecture \& Governance team based in Bangalore, India. In this role, you will be responsible for ingesting data from internal and external sources into our enterprise data lake, with a strong focus on the bronze layer of a medallion architecture. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data analysts, and technical teams to gather requirements, clarify business logic, support testing, and design practical solutions that improve reliability, usability, and scalability.



The ideal candidate combines strong technical data engineering skills with the ability to work independently, determine next steps, and communicate effectively with customers and stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.



This role is based in our Bangalore, India corporate office and reports directly to the Data Architecture \& Governance Manager for ISC.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integrations, and ETL/ELT workflows on Google Cloud Platform using BigQuery, Airflow, and Cloud Data Fusion.
* Ingest data from internal and external sources into the enterprise data lake, with primary ownership of the bronze layer within a medallion architecture.
* Analyze legacy systems, databases, workflows, and transformation logic to understand current\-state processes, dependencies, and opportunities for modernization.
* Document current\-state data flows and system behavior and develop recommendations for process improvement, architecture simplification, and legacy\-to\-cloud modernization.
* Use strong SQL skills to analyze source data, validate transformations, understand embedded business logic, and support data analysts with trusted datasets.
* Partner with business stakeholders and internal customers to gather requirements, clarify needs, support testing, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Work independently to identify next steps, resolve technical and process issues, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality data solutions.
* Apply data quality, governance, documentation, and security standards while continuously improving pipeline reliability, scalability, and performance.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* 3\&\#43; years of experience in data engineering, cloud data platforms, data integration, or related roles.
* Hands\-on experience building data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong working knowledge of BigQuery, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Data Fusion.
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to analyze legacy systems, investigate data issues, validate transformations, and support analytics users.
* Knowledge of Python and Data Engineering packages such as PySpark and Airflow

* Familiarity with data lake concepts and medallion architecture, especially bronze\-layer ingestion patterns.

* A hands\-on engineering mindset with the ability to move from analysis to design to delivery.

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
Senior Technical Lead
Bangalore, Karnataka
**Job Summary**
---------------


The **Data Management Analyst, Data \& Insights \- Data Governance** serves as a bridge between the technical and business sides, translating complex data requirements into practical governance policies, standards, controls, and operating practices. This role helps ensure that data is trusted, well\-defined, secure, and fit for business use by supporting data ownership, stewardship, data quality, metadata, lineage, and master data management practices. Working closely with stakeholders across business and technology teams, this role is responsible for implementing and continuously improving governance processes that increase the value, consistency, and responsible use of enterprise data.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* In addition to core data analyst capabilities such as data analysis, business communication, and problem solving, this role requires hands\-on experience with enterprise data governance and data management practices.
* **Data Governance Operating Model:** Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the data governance framework, including roles, responsibilities, decision rights, standards, policies, issue management, and governance routines. Coordinate with data owners, data stewards, and business stakeholders to embed governance practices into day\-to\-day operations.
* **Data Quality Management:** Perform data profiling, assessment, monitoring, and remediation activities to improve data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and fitness for use. Define data quality rules, thresholds, metrics, and reporting to track issues, root causes, and improvement progress.
* **Metadata, Business Glossary, and Lineage Management:** Maintain business definitions, data element standards, ownership, critical data element documentation, and lineage information to improve shared understanding, traceability, and discoverability of data assets. Support data catalog and metadata repository adoption.
* **Master Data Management:** Support the governance of core business data domains by helping define master and reference data standards, data ownership, matching and survivorship rules, quality controls, and change processes. Partner with business and technology teams to improve consistency of critical master data across systems.
* **Policy, Risk, and Compliance:** Help ensure data practices align with internal policies, regulatory requirements, privacy obligations, and control expectations. Support audit readiness by maintaining documentation related to standards, lineage, access considerations, and governance decisions.
* **AI Governance:** Support governance practices for AI agents and AI\-enabled workflows by helping ensure appropriate data use, ownership, documentation, risk awareness, and alignment with responsible AI, privacy, security, legal, and enterprise data governance standards. Partner with business, data, and technology teams to promote trusted, well\-governed, and compliant use of data in AI initiatives.
* **Data Standards and Architecture Collaboration:** Partner with data architects, engineers, and platform teams to align governance requirements with data models, integration patterns, and solution designs.
* **Governance Reporting and Issue Management:** Develop dashboards, scorecards, and management reports that track governance adoption, data quality performance, metadata coverage, stewardship engagement, and remediation status. Facilitate issue intake, prioritization, escalation, and follow\-through.
* **Stakeholder Engagement, Stewardship, and Change Management:** Act as a governance subject matter resource by providing guidance, training, and facilitation to data stewards and business partners. Lead working sessions that align stakeholders on definitions, controls, responsibilities, and remediation plans.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Track industry practices, governance maturity, and emerging data management needs, including AI\-ready data practices where relevant. Recommend and test process, control, and tool improvements that strengthen trust in enterprise data.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


* Proven experience in data governance, data management, data analysis or related roles within medium to large organizations.
* Strong understanding of core data governance concepts, including data ownership and stewardship, policy and standards management, issue management, data controls, and governance operating models.
* Hands\-on experience with data quality management, including profiling, rule definition, monitoring, remediation, and metric development.
* Hands\-on experience with metadata management, business glossary development, data cataloging, and data lineage documentation.
* Hands\-on experience master data management concepts and practices, including master and reference data, domain ownership, data standards, matching and survivorship, and lifecycle controls.
* Experience supporting AI governance practices that align with enterprise governance, privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g. SQL, Python) and reporting/BI platforms (e.g., Power BI).
* Proficiency with data governance tools, data catalogs, metadata repositories, and related workflow platforms (e.g., Collibra, Profisee).
* Solid understanding of data modeling, integration, and data architecture concepts relevant to governed data products and enterprise data assets.
* Knowledge of relevant regulatory, privacy, risk, and control requirements affecting enterprise data.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively to drive cross\-functional governance initiatives and deliver high\-quality outcomes.


**Other Requirements**
----------------------


**Must\-have:**Data quality management, master data management, metadata management experience across various data types; experience with data catalog and data governance tools such as Collibra, Profisee, Databricks


**Good\-to\-have:**experience with AI governance and understanding of responsible AI and integrated governance between data and AI use cases

title: Senior Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com .


**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Senior Cybersecurity Analyst is a senior technical member of Fluence's global security operations team, responsible for detecting, investigating, and responding to cyber threats across our enterprise, cloud, and product\-supporting environments. Working from Bengaluru as part of a follow\-the\-sun model, this role partners daily with IT infrastructure, application, risk, compliance, and business teams worldwide, and serves as an escalation point and mentor for junior analysts. The ideal candidate combines deep hands\-on experience in threat detection, investigation, and response with strong analytical judgment and the ability to explain technical risk clearly to both engineers and senior leadership. Day to day, this role works extensively with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Kusto Query Language, vulnerability assessment platforms such as Tenable, and ticketing and automation tooling including ServiceNow. Success in this role is measured by faster and more accurate threat detection, reduced dwell time and false positives, and measurable improvement in Fluence's overall security posture.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Threat Detection, Investigation and Response**

* Conduct threat monitoring and analysis using threat detection, investigation and response (TDIR) tooling, including security information and event management (SIEM) and extended detection and response (XDR) platforms.
* Conduct multi\-telemetry threat investigations to identify cyber threats originating both inside and outside the organization.
* Triage alerts from detection platforms, eliminate false positives, and escalate genuine attacks in line with defined procedures.
* Provide infrastructure teams with incident support, including mitigating actions to contain activity and advisory guidance for remediation.
* Carry out root cause analysis and follow\-up investigations to advise on prevention mechanisms and configuration changes.
* Work efficiently to meet organization\-specific SOC metrics and service level agreements.

**Detection Engineering and Continuous Improvement**

* Work with threat detection content development teams to tune existing detection platforms and create new detection content.
* Drive advanced threat hunting and automation initiatives using scripting and security orchestration tools.
* Maintain expertise in cloud security monitoring and the integration of cloud telemetry into SIEM and XDR platforms.
* Carry out analysis and testing to identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and other exposures, and to validate user policies.
* Recommend improvements to security architecture, controls and processes based on root cause analysis and emerging threats.
* Maintain current knowledge of security technologies, attacker techniques and available mitigations.

**Reporting and Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Document formal, technical incident reports for consumption by infrastructure teams and senior leadership.
* Support the development and running of reporting for compliance and infrastructure teams, as well as performance reporting for the security operations team.
* Develop and present security metrics and incident trends to senior leadership.
* Collaborate with IT, risk, compliance and business units to ensure holistic security coverage.

**Leadership and Team Development**

* Lead and mentor junior analysts in threat detection, investigation and incident response.
* Participate in and lead incident simulations, tabletop exercises, and red, blue and purple team activities.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and professional development within the security team.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

Candidates will be evaluated primarily on their ability to demonstrate the competencies required to be successful in the role. For reference, the typical education, experience and technical background of candidates in this role is as follows:


* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information security, cybersecurity or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in security operations analysis, incident response, red teaming, penetration testing, IT audit, network operations or enterprise risk management.
* Minimum 3 years of experience with regulatory compliance and information security management frameworks such as ISO 27000 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* CompTIA CySA\+ or Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate certification.
* Experience monitoring security information and event management (SIEM) systems and tools such as Microsoft Sentinel.
* Experience with network and security technologies such as firewalls, IDS/IPS and Microsoft Defender XDR.
* Hands\-on experience using analytical and query tools such as Microsoft Excel, Kusto Query Language (KQL) and SQL to support threat investigations, alert analysis, reporting and continuous improvement of detection capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and using vulnerability assessment technologies such as Tenable and Nessus.
* Experience monitoring networks, detecting threats and responding to incidents using platforms such as ServiceNow and Jira.
* Experience with report writing, investigative techniques and communicating to large audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in cybersecurity, information security or a related technical field.
* Additional certifications such as GIAC GCIH, GCIA or GCFA, CISSP, or a cloud security certification (for example Microsoft AZ\-500 or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
* Experience supporting a global, follow\-the\-sun security operations center across multiple regions and time zones.
* Experience securing cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform, including onboarding cloud telemetry into detection platforms.
* Scripting and automation capability using PowerShell, Python, KQL or security orchestration, automation and response (SOAR) tooling such as Logic Apps.
* Exposure to operational technology, industrial control systems, or the energy and critical infrastructure sectors.
* Familiarity with data protection and privacy requirements such as GDPR, and with frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Threat detection, investigation and response
* Strong decision making, with a proven ability to weigh the relative costs and benefits of potential actions and identify the most appropriate one
* Problem solving, critical thinking and troubleshooting under time pressure
* Influence and communication, with the ability to shape the opinions, plans and behaviors of technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Business alignment, demonstrated through an understanding of organizational mission, values and goals and the consistent application of that knowledge

Collaboration and relationship building, including the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across regions and functions


**Our Culture**

At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.


**Unleash Voices**

We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.


**Customer Fluent**

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.

Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
   

  

 Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy\-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
   

  

 Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9\.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2\.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
   

  

 With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to sit at the intersection of our
 **Security Research Engineering** 
 team and our
 **customers worldwide** 
 . This is a deeply technical, hands\-on, detection\-focused role for someone who understands how attacks against APIs and AI systems actually work — and can prove, in real customer traffic, whether a detection is firing correctly.
   

  

 This is a
 **high\-impact role.** 
 The value customers realize from the entire platform depends on the outcomes this team produces: whether our detections fire correctly, whether the threats that matter get surfaced, and whether customers trust what we tell them. You'll be the technical authority who validates the detections our researchers build (ModSecurity/WAF rules, API security signatures, AI security detections, OWASP Top 10 / API Top 10 / LLM Top 10 coverage), separates true positives from noise, hunts across global customer environments for business logic abuse and fraud, and closes the loop back to Research and Product to sharpen detection efficacy.
   

  

 You'll bring a deep understanding of the security landscape — the threat models, attacker techniques, and rapidly evolving AI security frontier — and you'll express that understanding through code: scripting, automating threat hunts, and using AI itself as a force multiplier in your investigations.
   

  

 Day to day, you'll work hand in hand with customers' own security teams to operationalize the
 **Traceable by Harness Protection module** 
 and then stay engaged as an
 **extended SOC and red team** 
 — continuously improving their security posture rather than handing off at go\-live.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Operationalize the Protection module. Work directly with customers' security teams to stand up and tune the Traceable by Harness Protection module in their environment, from initial rollout through steady\-state enforcement.
* Be their extended SOC and red team. Engage continuously — not as a one\-off deployment — acting as an extension of the customer's SOC to monitor and hunt, and as a red team to probe their defenses, steadily improving their overall security posture.
* Evaluate detections built by Security Research Engineering. Review and pressure\-test ModSecurity (ModSec) rulesets, API security detections, AI Security detections, and OWASP Top 10 / OWASP API Top 10 / OWASP LLM Top 10 coverage for accuracy, coverage gaps, and false\-positive rates before and after they reach customers.
* Validate true positives in production traffic. Partner directly with customer security teams to triage platform alerts, confirm genuine true positives, distinguish them from false positives and benign anomalies, and document the reasoning behind each verdict.
* Automate the hunt. Build scripts, tooling, and automated workflows — increasingly AI\-assisted — that scale threat hunting across many customers at once, rather than investigating one alert at a time by hand.
* Run threat hunting engagements globally. Proactively hunt across the API traffic of Harness customers worldwide for business logic abuse (BOLA/BFLA, parameter tampering, workflow abuse), account takeover, credential stuffing, scraping, carding, and fraud patterns that signature\-based detection alone won't catch.
* Black\-box test the platform and customer APIs. Attack detections and API endpoints the way a real adversary would — validating coverage, finding blind spots, and generating the adversarial traffic needed to confirm detections actually fire.
* Own the detection feedback loop. Turn field findings into concrete, prioritized input for Security Research Engineering and Product — new rule ideas, tuning recommendations, catalog/detection integration gaps, and coverage improvements.
* Reproduce and investigate incidents. Lead deep\-dive investigations into anomalous API behavior, trace root cause (including upstream CDN/WAF/gateway layers), and produce clear RCA documentation and findings for both technical and executive audiences.
* Weed out false positives and report on what matters (critical). Aggressively filter noise so customers aren't chasing false alarms, and deliver clear reports that surface genuine threat insights — helping customer teams focus their limited attention on the true incidents that actually require action. This signal\-over\-noise discipline is central to the value customers get from the platform.
* Reduce customer noise at the source. Tune detections to each customer's API catalog, business context, and legitimate integration patterns so false positives are suppressed before they ever reach an analyst.
* Be a trusted technical advisor. Translate detection logic and threat findings into language customer security leaders can act on, and help them mature their API and AI security posture.


 What You Bring
   

  

**Required**
* 4–6 years in security engineering, detection engineering, threat hunting, penetration testing, incident response, or a closely related discipline.
* A deep, current understanding of the security landscape — threat models, attacker techniques, and how attacks against APIs and AI systems actually play out.
* Ability to code and automate. You write your own tooling to scale threat hunting — this is not a point\-and\-click role.
* Ability to use AI for threat hunting. You actively leverage LLMs and AI\-assisted workflows to accelerate investigation, triage, and hunt automation.
* Black\-box penetration testing ability — you can attack an API or a detection with no prior knowledge and reason about what an adversary would do.
* Comfort working directly with enterprise customers globally — you can lead a technical conversation, defend a verdict, and write findings that stand up to scrutiny.


 Core Technical Requirements
   

  

 This is a core technical role. We expect real depth — not surface familiarity — across most of the following:
   

  

* Security frameworks \& threat models: OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP LLM (GenAI) Top 10; MITRE ATT\&CK, and MITRE ATLAS for AI/ML threats.
* API security: REST, GraphQL, and gRPC; authentication and authorization flows (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, session handling); and the full range of API attack techniques (BOLA/BFLA, mass assignment, injection, SSRF, rate\-limit and workflow abuse).
* AI / LLM security: prompt injection, sensitive\-information disclosure, improper output handling, excessive agency, and abuse of AI\-driven or agentic API endpoints — and how to detect them.
* Detection \& WAF engineering: hands\-on with WAF / ModSecurity rule logic — reading, writing, tuning, and reasoning about false\-positive / false\-negative tradeoffs.
* Offensive testing \& tooling: black\-box testing of APIs and detections using tools such as Burp Suite, Postman, and OWASP ZAP; generating adversarial traffic to confirm detections fire.
* Scripting \& automation: Python (or equivalent) to build investigation tooling and automated, increasingly AI\-assisted hunt workflows; comfort querying large volumes of traffic and telemetry.
* Threat hunting \& fraud analysis: distinguishing business logic abuse and fraud from legitimate traffic — account takeover, credential stuffing, scraping, carding, and payment fraud.


**Nice to Have**
* Familiarity with CDN, gateway, and upstream traffic architectures (Akamai, Cloudflare, and similar) and how they interact with detection at the edge.
* Prior experience in a customer\-facing security engineering, SOC, or professional services role.
* Certifications (a plus, not required). Because this role centers on API and AI security, the most relevant credentials are:
+ API security: Certified API Pentester (C\-APIPen), APIsec University ASCP, or PortSwigger Burp Suite Certified Practitioner (BSCP).
+ AI / LLM security: a hands\-on AI security certification such as CAISP (Certified AI Security Professional) or equivalent.
+ Offensive / web depth: OSWE, GWAPT, or OSCP.
+ Note: AI\-security certifications are still maturing, so demonstrated hands\-on ability weighs more heavily than any specific badge.


**Harness In The News**
* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5\.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale \| Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

 At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness\-privacy.relyance.ai/
   

  

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**
 We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.
   

  

 Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.
   

  

 If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io.
