title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-V&M-Senior Consultant-BVAL Complex security/ EGC
description:
**Strategy \& Transactions \| Valuation \& Modeling \| Complex Securities Valuation \| Senior Consultant**


Join our team of Strategy \& Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, strategy, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M\&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.


Position Summary

**Level: Senior or equivalent**


As a Senior at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for reviewing the valuation analysis/ models assisting client with their taxation planning and compliance; financial reporting in accordance with ‘US GAAP’ or ‘IFRS’ accounting standards. You will build, review, and validate quantitative models, interpret outputs in the context of applicable accounting standards, and draft client\-ready deliverables. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

**The team:**

The Complex Securities Valuation team, part of Deloitte Consulting Services, provides services relating to the full life cycle of Valuation, including policy and process assessments, and quantitative solutions to support the valuation of all types of financial instruments under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, ASC 842 and other financial reporting standards including complex derivatives, convertible securities, contingent consideration, contingent claims analysis, stock compensation, incremental borrowing rates, equity securities and other investment products. Valuation service offering also provides advisory services to financial institutions, governmental agencies and other private and public companies.

**Work you’ll do / Key Responsibilities:**


The key job responsibilities will be to:

* Conduct 409A common stock valuations and complex capital structure analyses using OPM (Black\-Scholes and Monte Carlo), PWERM, and hybrid methodologies; document DLOM/DLOC assumptions with appropriate support
* Apply and document fair value measurement methodologies under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, and ASC 842; ensure deliverables are defensible to external auditors
* Support Deloitte US and Deloitte India (Offices of the US) project teams in providing financial consulting services relating to preparing and auditing complex security valuations. Assist in the valuation of financial instruments for regulatory, financial, and 409A purposes.
* Create/assist in creating financial models, analyzing financial statements, conducting industry research, and writing reports
* Draft client\-ready valuation reports and memos including methodology rationale, model assumptions, sensitivity analyses, and concluded fair values; respond substantively to auditor and client review comments
* Deliver high\-quality valuation work products and assist other team members in India (Offices of the US), when required; and interact with internal clients and communicate with stakeholders in the US
* Supervise and review work of junior analysts; provide structured, technical feedback to build team capability and maintain quality standards across the engagement portfolio
* May need to work on other Deloitte Consulting engagements
* Support business development through proposal preparation, pitch materials, and thought leadership on emerging topics in financial instrument valuation


Qualifications

**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Strong background in mathematical finance at the Master's level \- degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, or a related technical discipline.
* Understanding financial valuation concepts is required. Applicants are expected to have strong analytical and computer skills. Quantitative analysis technical skills and experience with modeling and valuation theory (Monte\-Carlo Simulations, Binomial Lattice, Black Scholes, Options Theory, Geometric Brownian Motion), and tools (Bloomberg, and S\&P Capital IQ) are a plus.
* 4\-8 years of relevant Complex Securities Valuation experience

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* CFA Level II cleared or appeared
* Ability to explain difficult financial modeling/valuation concepts to diverse client contacts
* Conceptual and quantitative depth in valuation methodologies and concepts and underlying markets and models.

**Education:**

* Master's level \- degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, Business Administration in Finance


**Our purpose**  


Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
**Our people and culture**  


Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
**Professional development**  


At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
**Benefits to help you thrive**  


At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. description:

Job Description
About Us
Aeries Technology is a Nasdaq listed global professional services and consulting partner, headquartered in Mumbai, India, with centers in the USA, Mexico, Singapore, and Dubai. We provide mid\-size technology companies with the right mix of deep vertical specialty, functional expertise, and the right systems \& solutions to scale, optimize and transform their business operations with unique customized engagement models. Aeries is Great Place to Work certified by GPTW India, reflecting our commitment to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture for our employees.
About Business Unit
Darktrace is a global AI cybersecurity leader founded in 2013 in Cambridge, UK, by mathematicians and ex\-intelligence experts. Its flagship ActiveAI Security Platform uses Self\-Learning AI to detect and respond to threats across network, email, cloud, endpoint, OT, and identity — without relying on prior attack signatures.
Roles and Responsibility
Workday Systems Support Tech Analyst


Job Summary


As a Workday Systems Support Analyst within Darktrace’s TechOps Centre, you will be responsible for the operational support, monitoring, troubleshooting and maintenance of Workday integrations across HCM, Finance, Payroll and Adaptive Planning. Acting as a key technical resource, you will ensure the reliability, accuracy and performance of critical data exchanges between Workday and internal or third\-party systems.


The role focuses on integration support activities, including incident investigation, root cause analysis, integration monitoring, error resolution, data reconciliation and technical troubleshooting. You will leverage Workday integration technologies and diagnostic tools to proactively identify issues, minimise business disruption and improve platform stability.


Key Duties \& Responsibilities

* Provide L1 and L2 operational and technical support for Workday integrations supporting HCM, Financials, Payroll and Adaptive Planning.
* Monitor, investigate and resolve integration failures, data discrepancies, processing exceptions and interface performance issues.
* Troubleshoot inbound and outbound integrations using Workday integration technologies including:
	+ Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
	+ Core Connectors
	+ Workday Studio
	+ Cloud Connect integrations
	+ Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST APIs)
	+ Workday Extend applications where applicable
* Analyse integration logs, event subscriptions, business process transactions and audit trails to identify root causes and implement solutions.
* Support Payroll integrations, including PECI, payroll input processing and third\-party payroll interfaces.
* Support Finance integrations, including banking, procurement, expense, supplier, accounting and reporting interfaces.
* Maintain data integrity through reconciliation activities, validation checks and exception management.
* Support inbound and outbound file transfers, middleware interfaces and API\-based integrations.
* Collaborate with functional Workday teams to understand business requirements and investigate issues spanning security, business processes, reporting and integrations.
* Perform impact assessments for Workday releases, ensuring integrations remain compliant and operational following system updates.
* Maintain integration documentation, support runbooks, technical designs, support procedures and knowledge articles.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend automation, monitoring enhancements and process improvements.
* Work closely with Enterprise IT, Finance, People Operations, Payroll providers and third\-party vendors to resolve complex technical issues.


Qualifications \& Experience

* Experience supporting Workday integrations within a medium\-to\-large enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of Workday HCM, Financials, Payroll and/or Adaptive Planning.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday integration technologies including EIB, Core Connectors and Workday Studio.
* Experience troubleshooting Workday Web Services, APIs, calculated fields and data transformations.
* Knowledge of integration monitoring, log analysis, file\-based interfaces and batch processing.
* Experience performing root cause analysis and resolving complex technical incidents.
* Strong understanding of data structures, data mapping and data validation techniques.
* Familiarity with XML, XSLT, JSON, REST and SOAP technologies.
* Experience working within ITSM processes, including incident, problem and change management.
* Strong analytical, diagnostic and troubleshooting skills.
* Workday Integration Certification.
* Experience supporting PECI and payroll integrations.
* Experience supporting Adaptive Planning integrations and data synchronisation.
* Experience with middleware platforms such as Boomi, MuleSoft or Azure Integration Services.
* Experience supporting Workday Extend applications.
* Knowledge of security administration and integration security groups within Workday.


Success Measures

* Integration incidents are resolved within agreed service levels with minimal business impact.
* Critical HCM, Finance, Payroll and Adaptive integrations achieve high availability and reliability.
* Integration failures are proactively identified, investigated and remediated before impacting users.
* Root causes are documented and recurring technical issues are reduced through permanent fixes and automation.
* Data integrity and reconciliation controls are consistently maintained across integrated systems.
* Workday releases and system updates are successfully assessed and implemented without disruption to integration services.
* Technical documentation, runbooks and support procedures remain accurate and up to date.


What You Will Gain

* Deep technical expertise across Workday HCM, Financials, Payroll and Adaptive Planning integrations.
* Exposure to enterprise\-scale integration architecture supporting critical business operations.
* Hands\-on experience with APIs, middleware, data transformation and cloud integration technologies.
* Opportunities to contribute to platform optimisation, automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* A key role in ensuring the stability, scalability and reliability of Darktrace's core business systems and data ecosystem.

title: Sr IT Operations Engineer
description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**

**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** **At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**

**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**

**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**

**Your Role: Sr IT Operations Engineer**


The role requires strong technical breadth and the ability to work across multiple technology areas rather than being limited to a single technology domain. The individual should be comfortable understanding problems across applications, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, security, access, and reporting, while partnering with specialist teams where deeper expertise is required.

**Your Responsibilities:**

**Operations Excellence \& IT Operations**

* Act as a primary technology contact for assigned EKS applications, platforms, and services.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical oversight and operational support across EKS technology environments.
* Administer and govern technology services including infrastructure, security groups, GitHub teams, Power BI workspaces, support groups, and related access.
* Review and approve appropriate EKS technology, access, and support requests.
* Manage and coordinate ITSM processes including Incidents, Changes, and Problems.
* Identify recurring operational issues and drive improvements to reliability, efficiency, and user experience.
**Technical Problem Resolution \& Engineering Support**

* Investigate and help resolve complex technical issues across applications, cloud platforms, databases, analytics, and enterprise technology services.
* Act as a technical problem\-solving partner for EKS Business Operations, Analytics, Engineering teams, and vendors.
* Troubleshoot issues involving technologies such as Azure, SQL, Power BI, Databricks, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise applications.
* Work with technical specialists to identify root cause, define resolution paths, and ensure actions are completed.
* Provide technical guidance to Project Managers, Business Analysts, and other stakeholders when technology decisions or assessments are required.
**Cloud, Infrastructure \& Technology Initiatives**

* Support and lead technology initiatives across Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Drive initiatives such as operating system upgrades, cloud security assessments, infrastructure improvements, and technology health checks.
* Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Data, IAM, and Security teams to implement improvements.
* **Security Engineering \& Risk Reduction**
* Review and assess Critical and High security alerts impacting EKS applications and technology environments.
* Partner with InfoSec, IAM, Infrastructure, and other technology teams to investigate and remediate security risks.
* Support implementation of security improvements such as access control enhancements, credential management, and authentication hardening.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to closure.
* **DataOps \& Technology Cost Optimization**
* Support and lead DataOps initiatives, including Databricks\-related operational and cost optimization activities.
* Analyze technology usage and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary costs.
* Partner with Data, Cloud, Engineering, and vendors to implement optimization measures.
**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key technical liaison between EKS teams and external technology vendors.
* Use technical understanding to challenge vendor recommendations and identify gaps.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding vendor actions and escalate when required.
* Ensure vendor dependencies and blockers are identified early and driven to closure.
**Engineering Visibility, Reporting \& Analytics**

* Develop and enhance operational and technology reports to provide actionable visibility into EKS environments.
* Support reporting around security posture, incidents, operational health, technology usage, and cost optimization.
* Act as an in\-house Power BI resource for EKS where required.
* Ensure reporting data is accurate, reliable, and actionable.
**Application Modernization \& Continuous Improvement**

* Contribute to application and technology modernization initiatives.
* Work with vendors and internal engineering teams during application upgrades, improvements, and technical changes.
**Cross\-Functional Engineering Collaboration**

* Participate in technical reviews and technology assessments.
* Align solutions with enterprise architecture, security, and technology standards.
* Collaborate effectively with IAM, Infrastructure, Data, InfoSec, Engineering, Mobile Deployment, and other enterprise teams.
* **What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**
* 

* Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in enterprise technology operations, application operations/support, cloud operations, application engineering, or a related technology role.
* Strong experience in technical troubleshooting and problem resolution within enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of relational database concepts, integration technologies, application interfaces, and enterprise technology environments.
* Working knowledge of at least one public cloud platform, preferably Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of ITSM/ITIL, including Incident, Change, and Problem Management.
* Experience working with third\-party vendors in a large enterprise organization.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and drive technical issues to closure.
**What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):**

* 

* Experience with enterprise application or SaaS operations.
* Experience with Azure and/or GCP cloud operations.
* Experience working with Infrastructure, IAM, InfoSec, or enterprise security teams.
* Experience with Power BI, SSRS, or other reporting/analytics platforms.
* Knowledge of Databricks or other modern data platforms.
* Experience supporting application modernization or technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience with IoT projects.
* Relevant cloud, ITSM, security, or technology certifications.

title: Information Security Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Title**


Information Security Operations Engineer**Job Description Summary**


Selected Candidate works within the Security Operations Center to improve, tune, and enhance security alerts, responses, and remediation of detected issues The engineer will also work within the Incident Management process to remove threats and vulnerabilities within the organization. This role collaborates with other Information Security and IT Operational teams to maintain a secure environment and incident response capabilities. As part of the Global Security Operations Center team, he/she should be responsible for improving security operations and monitoring security events in EDR, permitter scanning, threat detection, preventative advanced threat hunting, across all security tools. This job requires Flexibility of working in 24/7 rotational shifts which includes night shift and weekends.**Job Description**

* Serves as the regional point of contact for security escalations/requests and escalates requests to Security architecture as needed.
* Responsible for the identification and assessment of enterprise risks. Identifies, evaluates, and tests appropriate security products, tools, and systems to ensure alignment with the CushWake global security posture
* Articulates security policies, guidelines and standards to customers and developers. Able to apply theories, concepts, principles, and methodologies to difficult but conventional assignments. Assignments are given in terms of objectives to be met.
* Works independently within an established framework.
* Develop techniques and procedures for conducting IS and cyber security risk assessments and compliance audits, the evaluation and testing of hardware, firmware, and software for possible impact on system security, and the investigation and resolution of security incidents.
* Implement IS and cyber security policies and take measures against intrusion, frauds, attacks, or leaks.
* Continue to build knowledge of the organization, processes, and customers. Performs a range of straightforward assignments. Use prescribed guidelines or policies to analyze and resolve problems. Receives a moderate level of guidance and direction
* Partners with Security Architecture on critical scope delivery
* Reviews security INC(s) to ensure proper processes have been followed and to identify additional IoA(s)/IoC(s).
* Perform proactive threat hunting using hypothesis, and telemetry from endpoints, identities, cloud and network to identify malicious activity, abnormal behaviors, and emerging attacker techniques.
* Serves as the security stakeholder for IR/MIM activities until Security Architecture and/or senior leadership can engage.

  


INCO: “Cushman \& Wakefield”
